title: Understand Solutions to Systems Core Test
description: Understand a system solution as an ordered pair that makes both equations true.

questions.questionText: The lines y = 2x + 4 and y = -x - 5 intersect at (-3, -2). What is the solution to the system?
questions.explanation: A solution to a system is an ordered pair that makes both equations true. On a graph, it is the intersection point.

questions.questionText: Does (2, -1) solve the system y = -3x + 5 and y = -x + 1?
options: No; it satisfies only the first equation
No; it satisfies neither equation
No; it satisfies only the second equation
Yes; it makes both equations true
questions.correctAnswer: Yes; it makes both equations true
questions.explanation: A solution to a system is an ordered pair that makes both equations true. On a graph, it is the intersection point.

questions.questionText: What does the solution to a system of two linear equations represent on a graph?
options: the slope of the steeper line
the point where the two lines intersect
any point that satisfies the first equation
the point where one line crosses the y-axis
questions.correctAnswer: the point where the two lines intersect
questions.explanation: A solution to a system is an ordered pair that makes both equations true. On a graph, it is the intersection point.
